Mumbai, Jan 4 (IANS) Actress-author Twinkle Khanna, who is expecting her third child, was spotted in Mumbai on Monday, and this time her look was totally different from the way she has been seen in the past.
She was also spotted with her mother Dimple Kapadia and filmmaker husband Akshay Kumar. The trio were seen at the Mumbai airport. Twinkle wore a printed outfit, which she teamed with a pair of white shoes.
On the work front, Twinkle is currently busy promoting her upcoming book, "Mrs Funnybones", which is a compilation of her funny columns from the past. Her next book, "The Legend Of Lakshmi Prasad", will be released on July 9.
--IANS

But these days there's a new-look beachfront complex under construction that will open in time for the Memorial Day weekend.
"New construction is back," said Craig Smith, president of the New Smyrna Beach Condominium Association. "We have four new projects under construction and we're close to two others. There's more going on than we've seen in a long time."
The projects include a new $1.4 million, 45-unit condo complex that will open in early March and a $6 million, 46-unit condo complex that will open in May.

The self-styled “Coyote Cartel,” which operates in the state of Michoacan, is battling the authorities in the city of Apatzingan, where it has long ruled. The vigilantes believe the cartel has lost control of the city to the Michoacan state police.

But the cartel has sent a message that its authority remains intact. On Wednesday morning, a group of armed men in pickup trucks arrived at the CVS pharmacy in Apatzingan and set it on fire. original:
premise behind a national project launched by the Cleveland Museum of Art and the Cleveland Foundation.
The two groups are hosting a competition for anyone age 13 and up to draw their favorite places in Northeast Ohio. The winners will be announced in May.
The program is called Open Chalk Art, and it's part of a larger initiative called Open Doors, which is a year-long celebration of the museum's 150th anniversary.
"Open Chalk Art is a unique way for community members to come together, to come together with artists and with art," said Elizabeth Krasnoff, director of Public Programs at the Cleveland Museum of Art.
"There's a lot of value in that. And it's a way for us to give back to the community, and as a museum, we love to give back to the community."
The program will award three winners with $100 gift cards, and five honorable mentions will earn $50 gift cards. The public can submit their entries online.

We are young, and we have no plans to sell. The loan officer said the borrower would need to pay PMI until the equity was $150,000.

-- Just Getting Started
DEAR JUST GETTING STARTED: No, you are not required to pay PMI until the equity in your house reaches $150,000. If the loan officer told you anything different, you should demand to see his documentation.

Macquarie to Newcastle are being urged to slow down this summer, as the City of Newcastle has reinstated a 40km/h speed limit for motorists in the CBD.
From today, motorists in the Newcastle CBD must observe a 40km/h speed limit on Hunter Street and Scott Street between Worth Place and Telford Street.
The change, originally announced in December 2018, was a response to a growing number of pedestrian and cyclist injuries, and a significant increase in the use of public transport, cycling and walking in the area.
The 40km/h speed limit is in addition to the existing speed limit of 60km/h on Hunter Street and Scott Street from the intersection of Hunter Street and King Street to the intersection of Scott Street and Wakefield Street.
The City of Newcastle has also upgraded electronic signage to remind motorists of the speed limit.
MORE NEWS:
The speed limit change will be in place until the end of December.
"This is a win for the thousands
